currentRoundInspection.scope: Three actually inspected exterior pictures and standard viewer PMTiles/DEM. No bespoke plans/surveys researched or reference photos redistributed. Elevated views are older; exact current finish/hidden details and height datum remain approximate.

pictures.author: Gábor Bakó
pictures.observed: Actually inspected aerial front/side photograph. Broad rectangular masonry body has high semicircular side lunettes and lower paired round-headed windows, shallow green roof around a very large cylindrical drum with closely spaced pale columns. Green dome/cross above heavy circular cornice; eastern eight-column pedimented portico and two smaller green-domed towers connected by low wings. Rear roof has a parapeted terrace/hip-like surfaces. Nearby castle, museum, seminary and retaining walls are separate objects.

pictures.author: Zairon
pictures.observed: Actually inspected frontal photograph. Eight pale Corinthian-like columns support a deep portico, broad entablature and triangular pediment. Recessed central rectangular dark timber portal. Two connecting wings each have a genuine open lower round arch, upper shallow relief band and balustrade. Lateral towers have square lower bodies with small round oculi and octagonal upper stages with tall dark round-headed fields and green hemispherical caps/crosses. Central drum has alternating tall pale columns and darker rectangular window bays, heavy cornice and green copper dome/orb/cross. Fine capital carving, inscription and relief subjects are unresolved.

pictures.author: Civertan Grafikai Stúdió (individual photographer unspecified)
pictures.observed: Actually inspected older elevated overview (uploaded2006; capture date unspecified). Long pale body shows one very large side lunette and another smaller semicircular field high under the cornice, paired lower round-headed fields near the rear, vertical pilasters and a thick plain lower wall. Rear roof appears as brown/gray terrace with parapet while forward pitched roof/caps are oxidized green. Large central colonnaded drum and dominant green dome, smaller side domes and deep portico agree with front reference. Supports broad forms, not current finish; exact rear and roof surfaces remain estimates.
